report_name: FBI Arrests Suspected ShinyHunters Hacker in FBIJobs.gov Breach

threat_actors.name: ShinyHunters
threat_actors.description: A notorious extortion-focused hacking collective that claimed responsibility for the September 2026 breach of the FBIJobs.gov portal. The group is known for data theft from large organizations and monetizing the data through sales on dark web forums or extortion.
threat_actors.goals: Financial gain through data sales and extortion.

attack_patterns.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
attack_patterns.description: The ShinyHunters group exploited an unpatched vulnerability in the third-party platform used for the FBIJobs.gov portal to gain initial access.

vulnerabilities.name: Unpatched FBIJobs.gov Platform Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: An unspecified vulnerability in a third-party platform used for the FBIJobs.gov portal, which a contractor failed to patch, allowing ShinyHunters to gain initial access.

identities.name: Federal Bureau of Investigation
identities.description: The U.S. federal law enforcement agency whose job application portal, FBIJobs.gov, was breached by the ShinyHunters group in September 2026.

infrastructure.name: ShinyHunters Dark Web Marketplace
infrastructure.description: Dark web forums or marketplaces where the ShinyHunters group attempts to sell data stolen from victims.

indicators.name: Potential Web Application Exploitation Attempt (SQLi/XSS)
indicators.pattern:
title: Potential Web Application Exploitation Attempt (SQLi/XSS)
id: 3b1a9c8d-6f3e-4b2a-8c1d-9e0f1a2b3c4d
status: experimental
description: 'Detects common web application attack payloads such as SQL injection or Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) in URL parameters, which are techniques known to be used by groups like ShinyHunters.'
references:
  - https://tech-insider.org/fbi-arrests-shinyhunters-suspect-3tb-employee-hack-2026/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-09
tags:
  - attack.t1190
level: medium
logsource:
  category: webserver
detection:
  selection_sqli:
    c-uri|contains:
      - ' union '
      - ' select '
      - ' from '
      - ' where '
      - ' and 1=1'
      - ' or 1=1'
  selection_xss:
    c-uri|contains:
      - '<script>'
      - 'alert('
      - 'onerror='
  condition: 1 of selection_*
indicators.description: This indicator detects common web application attack payloads in URL parameters, such as those used for SQL injection or XSS, which are techniques associated with ShinyHunters.

indicators.name: Potential Web Shell Creation
indicators.pattern:
title: Potential Web Shell Creation on Web Server
id: 7d4e5f6a-1b2c-4d3e-8f9a-0b1c2d3e4f5a
status: experimental
description: 'Detects the creation of files with common web shell extensions in web server directories. This is a common persistence technique for actors like ShinyHunters after exploiting a web vulnerability.'
references:
  - https://tech-insider.org/fbi-arrests-shinyhunters-suspect-3tb-employee-hack-2026/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-09
tags:
  - attack.t1505.003
level: high
logsource:
  category: file_event
detection:
  selection_ext:
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '.aspx'
      - '.asp'
      - '.php'
      - '.jsp'
  selection_path:
    TargetFilename|contains:
      - '\inetpub\wwwroot\'
      - '/var/www/html/'
  condition: all of selection_*
indicators.description: This indicator detects the creation of files with common web shell extensions in web server directories, a TTP associated with ShinyHunters for maintaining persistence.
